CREATE TABLE items_g1 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ttl TEXT,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    avg_rtg_30d REAL,
    rtg_ct INTEGER,
    prc REAL,
    str_nm TEXT,
    main_cat TEXT,
    desc_txt TEXT,
    feat_lst TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE fdbk_g1 (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_id TEXT,
    ref_id TEXT,
    uid TEXT,
    rtg REAL,
    ttl TEXT,
    body TEXT,
    ts INTEGER,
    hlp_ct INTEGER,
    vrf INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g1(ref_id)
)

CREATE TABLE taxn_g1 (
    ref_id TEXT,
    cat_lvl INTEGER,
    cat_nm TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g1(ref_id)
)

CREATE TABLE attrs_g1 (
    ref_id TEXT,
    attr_key TEXT,
    attr_val TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g1(ref_id)
)

CREATE TABLE items_g2 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ttl TEXT,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    prc INTEGER,
    prc_usd REAL,
    str_nm TEXT,
    main_cat TEXT,
    feat_lst TEXT,
    img_ct INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE fdbk_g2 (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_id TEXT,
    ref_id TEXT,
    uid TEXT,
    rtg REAL,
    ttl TEXT,
    body TEXT,
    ts INTEGER,
    hlp_ct INTEGER,
    vrf TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g2(ref_id)
)

CREATE TABLE items_g3 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ttl TEXT,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    rtg_ct INTEGER,
    prc REAL,
    str_nm TEXT,
    main_cat TEXT,
    desc_txt TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE fdbk_g3 (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    ref_id TEXT,
    uid TEXT,
    rtg REAL,
    ttl TEXT,
    body TEXT,
    ts TEXT,
    hlp_ct INTEGER,
    vrf INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g3(ref_id)
)

CREATE TABLE fdbk_stats_g1 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    review_ct INTEGER,
    pct_5star REAL,
    avg_hlp REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g1(ref_id)
)

sql:
SELECT 'g1' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat

SELECT 'g2' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g2 WHERE main_cat LIKE '%Electronics%' GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g3 WHERE main_cat LIKE '%Electronics%' GROUP BY main_cat
SELECT 'g2' g, COUNT(*) total, SUM(prc IS NOT NULL) prc_notnull, SUM(prc_usd IS NOT NULL) usd_notnull, MIN(prc), MAX(prc), MIN(prc_usd), MAX(prc_usd) FROM items_g2

SELECT 'g1' g, MIN(prc), MAX(prc), SUM(prc IS NOT NULL), COUNT(*) FROM items_g1
UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', MIN(prc), MAX(prc), SUM(prc IS NOT NULL), COUNT(*) FROM items_g3
SELECT DISTINCT rtg FROM fdbk_g1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10

WITH elec AS (
  SELECT ref_id, prc AS price_usd FROM items_g1 WHERE main_cat = 'All Electronics'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ref_id, prc_usd AS price_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE main_cat = 'All Electronics'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ref_id, prc AS price_usd FROM items_g3 WHERE main_cat = 'All Electronics'
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ref_id FROM elec WHERE price_usd IS NOT NULL AND price_usd <= 40
),
revs AS (
  SELECT f.rtg FROM fdbk_g1 f JOIN eligible e ON f.ref_id = e.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.rtg FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN eligible e ON f.ref_id = e.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.rtg FROM fdbk_g3 f JOIN eligible e ON f.ref_id = e.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rtg = 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_star,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rtg = 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_1star
FROM revs

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ref_id, uid, ts, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g1 GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING c>1)) dup_g1,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ref_id, uid, ts, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING c>1)) dup_g2,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ref_id, uid, ts, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g3 GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING c>1)) dup_g3

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ref_id, uid, ts, body, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g1 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING c>1)) full_dup_g1,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ref_id, uid, ts, body, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING c>1)) full_dup_g2,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ref_id, uid, ts, body, COUNT(*) c FROM fdbk_g3 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING c>1)) full_dup_g3

WITH elec AS (
  SELECT ref_id, prc AS price_usd FROM items_g1 WHERE main_cat = 'All Electronics'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ref_id, prc_usd AS price_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE main_cat = 'All Electronics'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ref_id, prc AS price_usd FROM items_g3 WHERE main_cat = 'All Electronics'
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ref_id FROM elec WHERE price_usd IS NOT NULL AND price_usd <= 40
),
revs AS (
  SELECT f.ref_id, f.uid, f.ts, f.body, f.rtg FROM fdbk_g1 f JOIN eligible e ON f.ref_id = e.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.ref_id, f.uid, f.ts, f.body, f.rtg FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN eligible e ON f.ref_id = e.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.ref_id, f.uid, f.ts, f.body, f.rtg FROM fdbk_g3 f JOIN eligible e ON f.ref_id = e.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body) > 500
)
SELECT COUNT(*) rows_total,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ref_id || '|' || uid || '|' || ts) distinct_reviews,
       SUM(rtg=1.0) one_star_rows,
       SUM(rtg=1.0)/CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL)*100 pct_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM revs GROUP BY ref_id, uid, ts HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) dup_groups
FROM revs
